PROJECT TITLE
AI-Assisted Precision Agriculture for Climate-Resilient Smallholder Farming

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
GreenHarvest Labs, an Indian NGO based in Maharashtra, proposes to develop and deploy AI-assisted irrigation and soil monitoring tools for smallholder farmers. This initiative aims to significantly reduce agricultural water consumption, optimize resource use, and enhance crop yield resilience against the escalating impacts of climate change. We seek funding between INR 25 lakh and INR 1 crore to implement this innovative climate-tech solution, fostering sustainable agriculture and improving farmer livelihoods in Maharashtra.

PROBLEM & NEED
Smallholder farmers in Maharashtra face severe challenges from water scarcity, unpredictable weather patterns, and soil degradation, exacerbated by climate change. Traditional farming methods often lead to inefficient water use and suboptimal yields, threatening food security and farmer incomes. There is an urgent need for accessible, affordable, and data-driven solutions to empower these farmers to adapt and thrive in a changing climate.

APPROACH & ACTIVITIES
*   Develop AI models for real-time soil moisture, nutrient, and weather data analysis.
*   Design and deploy low-cost, robust sensor networks suitable for small farms.
*   Create an intuitive mobile application providing personalized irrigation and fertilization recommendations.
*   Conduct pilot projects with 50-100 small farmers in selected regions of Maharashtra.
*   Provide comprehensive training and ongoing technical support to participating farmers.

EXPECTED IMPACT
This project is projected to achieve a 20-30% reduction in water usage and a 10-15% improvement in crop yields for participating farmers. Beyond these immediate benefits, it will enhance climate resilience, reduce input costs, improve farmer incomes, and promote sustainable agricultural practices across the region. The scalable model has the potential to positively impact thousands of smallholder families.

BUDGET SUMMARY
We request funding in the range of INR 25 lakh to INR 1 crore. This budget will cover research and development of AI models, procurement and deployment of sensor hardware, software development for the mobile application, pilot project implementation, farmer training, and operational costs.

CONCLUSION
GreenHarvest Labs is committed to leveraging climate-tech innovations to build a more sustainable and resilient agricultural future for smallholder farmers in India. This project offers a tangible, impactful solution to critical challenges, aligning with national sustainability goals and CSR objectives. We invite partners to support this transformative initiative.
